x: With two laps to go he looked stronger than ever and simply tore past Glamorgan's McAndrew to reach sixth place at the bell with the bearded Perry 30yds ahead.

Imagine their dismay then when our international runner appeared only 27 seconds ahead of Reading's McAndrew. Geoff's comment "there was nothing to go for, it's in the bag" showed remarkable confidence in his team-mates, confidence that was, as it happened, justified.
Taking the lead twice in the early stages he kept his form well and was edged out of a scoring position by McAndrew, who finished stronger over the last 500 yards than most of a class field.
John was another having his first outing in this race, and what an initiation it was! As he waited to start he found himself alongside McAndrew (Reading), Ford (Aldershot), Watson (Cambridge) & D.
